excerpt: In the first year of physics run, the E949 experiment at Brookhaven National Laboratory has already collected 1.8x10^12 kaons stopping in the target. Combined with prior E787 results, Br(K+ -> pi+ nu nubar) = (1.47+1.30-0.89) x 10^-10.
title: Rare kaon decay from E949 at BNL: K+ -> pi+ nu anti-nu
